bullets.text: A rashly driven MTC bus killed a woman near Puzhal, and the office should monitor road safety measures.
A private bus ran over a woman near Nazarethpet, and the office should track transit safety enforcement.
Two female wardens were booked for harassing a plus-one student from Adambakkam, and the office should monitor the case.
Two accused in a shopkeeper murder case were booked under the Goondas Act in Tiruttani, and the office should monitor law and order.
Over 3,000 streetlights remain non-functional in Avadi despite maintenance contracts, and the office should urge local authorities to fix them.
Revenue officials surveyed government poramboke lands in Poonamallee Kumananchavadi, and the office should watch land administration updates.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated Rs 125 crore for AI assistive devices for persons with disability, and the office should oversee the scheme rollout.
Amazon warned engineers about AI productivity traps in software development, and the department should watch industry trends.
